A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. A sits second to the left of B. D is an immediate neighbour of A. B sits to the immediate left of C. E sits second to the right of C. F sits third to the left of D. What is the position of F with respect to A?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Second to the left) है।

questions.question: In a row of 27 students facing North, Varun is 12th from the right end. If Nisha is 9th to the left of Varun, what is Nisha's position from the left end of the line?

Below is a statement and two courses of action (I) and (II). You have to assume everything in both of these to be true and on the basis of the information given in the statement, select the option which depicts the relationship between the statement and the courses of actions.Statement: Increase in screen time leads to straining of eyes.Courses of Action:(I) One should watch programs only on television rather than laptop/mobile.(II) One should carefully assess their screen time and have proper diet and exercise to avoid straining of eyes.

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements:  All cars are mirrors.Some eggs are mirrors.No houses are mirrors.  Conclusions:(I) Some eggs are not houses.(II) No houses are cars.10920
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.) है।

Given below is a statement followed by two possible reasons numbered I and II. Read the statement carefully and decide which of the two reasons explains the event/observation/information given in the statement. Statement: Despite having a thriving economy, many people are leaving City G due to a severe water crisis.Reasons: I. City G's water supply infrastructure is outdated and cannot meet the current demand.II. Nearby cities offer better job opportunities and a higher standard of living.
options: Neither I nor II is a possible reason.
Only I is a possible reason.
Only II is a possible reason.
Both I and II are possible reasons.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Both I and II are possible reasons.) है।
